title: Score 足够但存在 Veto
asserts: mapped score may be in ARMED or higher band before veto
blocking veto forces downgrade of state and Action
R/R < 2 or stale/conflict/unverified thesis counts as veto
final Action is WAIT or PREPARE, never ENTER
degradation or veto reasons are recorded
notes: High model tiers with an explicit blocking veto (e.g. R/R N/A or data conflict); Decision Validator must win over raw score.
